headline: Binance Investigates Potential $5 Billion Hack as Withdrawals Are Suspended
summary: Binance suspended withdrawals while investigating a potential breach exceeding $5 billion, causing a sharp fall in bitcoin. Stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle froze over $3 billion.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, and major security incidents can disrupt global digital asset liquidity.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Security breaches at major exchanges lower investor confidence and prompt selling pressure across crypto assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A potential multi-billion dollar breach and withdrawal suspension at the world's largest crypto exchange triggered risk-off sentiment.
